Instead of `timeInterval` being the total time of the session, it is the time to wait between each "play" of the bot in the session.

For a bot with the following params:
```javascript
{
  score: { min: 1, max: 3 },
  scoreInterval: { min: 1, max: 1 },
  timeInterval: { min: 10, max: 20 },
  freezeTime: { min: 5, max: 10 },
}
```

A session could be:

Session Max Score: 2
Runs:
1. Score: 0, Session Score: 0, wait: 12s
2. Score: 1, Session Score: 1, wait: 15s
3. Score: 2, Session Score: 2, freeze: 7min

Session Max Score: 3
Runs:
1. Score: 2, Session Score: 0, wait: 11s
2. Score: 3, Session Score: 1, wait: 17s
3. Score: 4, Session Score: 2, wait: 19s
4. Score: 5, Session Score: 3, freeze: 8min

def rollup_gc(items):
    items=[(l,d) for (l,d) in items if ok(d)]
    if not items: return "NONE FOUND"
    dates=sorted(d for _,d in items)
    return {"count":len(items),"first_date":dates[0],"last_date":dates[-1],
            "people":sorted(set(l for l,_ in items))}

def rollup_tl(items):
    items=[(e,a,d) for (e,a,d) in items if (d is None or ok(d))]
    if not items: return "NONE FOUND"
    dts=sorted(d for _,_,d in items if d is not None)
    return {"count":len(items),
            "first_date":dts[0] if dts else None,
            "last_date":dts[-1] if dts else None,
            "events":sorted(set(e for e,_,_ in items)),
            "people":sorted(set(a for _,a,_ in items if a is not None))}

def rollup_rev(items):
    if not items: return "NONE FOUND"
    items=[(l,s,d) for l,s,d in items if ok(d)]
    if not items: return "NONE FOUND"
    dts=sorted(d for _,_,d in items)
    return {"count":len(items),"first_date":dts[0],"last_date":dts[-1],
            "people":sorted(set(l for l,_,_ in items)),
            "states":sorted(set(s for _,s,_ in items))}

\\n\\ud83d\\udcdd Walkthrough\\n\\n## Walkthrough\\n\\nAdds combo rarity, unlock cost, and level progression to combos; new ScriptableObjects and editor tooling for rarity data; Memory gains unlock/level persistence helpers; UI updated to render locked/special combos via a new SpecialComboCell and rarity visuals.\\n\\n## Changes\\n\\n|Cohort / File(s)|Summary|\\n|---|---|\\n|**Core Combo Definition**
`Assets/Scripts/ScriptableObjects/ComboDefinition.cs`|Added `ERarityEnum` (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic), `UnlockCost`, `Rarity`, `LevelMultipliers`, and computed properties `Locked`, `Level`, `MaxLevel` backed by `Memory` helpers.|\\n|**Rarity Data Infrastructure**
`Assets/Scripts/ScriptableObjects/ComboRarityData.cs`, `Assets/Scripts/ScriptableObjects/ComboRarityDefinition.cs`, `Assets/Scripts/ScriptableObjects/ComboCellRarityData.cs`|New ScriptableObjects: `ComboRarityData` (singleton, editor FillComboRarities), `ComboRarityDefinition` (level requirements), and `CombosCellRarityData`/`ComboCellRarityData` (rarity display data and reset on load).|\\n|**Memory Persistence**
`Assets/Scripts/Helper/Memory.cs`|Added `IsComboUnlocked`, `UnlockCombo`, `GetComboLevel`, and `IncreaseComboLevel` to persist and query combo unlock state and levels.|\\n|**UI & Cells**
`Assets/Scripts/UI/ComboScreen.cs`, `Assets/Scripts/UI/SpecialComboCell.cs`|`ComboScreen` conditionally instantiates a `SpecialComboCell` for locked or non-Common combos; `LockedComboCell` renamed/refactored to `SpecialComboCell`, uses a `SerializedDictionary` for visuals, handles unlock flow and currency updates.|\\n|**Assets / Meta**
`Assets/Resources/Combos/*`, `Assets/Scripts/ScriptableObjects/*.meta`, `Assets/Resources/Combos/*.asset.meta`, `Assets/Art/Textures/UI/*.meta`|Added folder/meta entries and asset meta files for rarity assets and new scriptable object meta files; new texture meta entries for rare backgrounds/frames.|\\n\\n## Sequence Diagram\\n\\n```mermaid\\nsequenceDiagram\\n participant ComboScreen as ComboScreen\\n participant ComboDefinition as ComboDefinition\\n participant Memory as Memory\\n participant SpecialComboCell as SpecialComboCell\\n participant RarityData as CombosCellRarityData\\n\\n ComboScreen->>ComboDefinition: read Locked, Rarity\\n ComboDefinition->>Memory: IsComboUnlocked(name)\\n Memory-->>ComboDefinition: unlocked/locked\\n\\n alt Locked or Rarity != Common\\n ComboScreen->>SpecialComboCell: Instantiate _specialPrefab\\n SpecialComboCell->>ComboDefinition: evaluate Locked\\n alt Locked\\n SpecialComboCell->>RarityData: request visuals for Rarity\\n RarityData-->>SpecialComboCell: return sprites/text\\n SpecialComboCell->>Memory: UnlockCombo(name) [on user action]\\n Memory-->>SpecialComboCell: persist result\\n else Unlocked (special)\\n SpecialComboCell->>RarityData: request visuals for Rarity\\n RarityData-->>SpecialComboCell: return sprites/text\\n end\\n else Common & Unlocked\\n ComboScreen->>ComboScreen: Instantiate regular cell and add to list\\n end\\n```\\n\\n## Estimated Code Review Effort\\n\\n\\ud83c\\udfaf 3 (Moderate) | \\u23f1\\ufe0f ~22 minutes\\n\\n## Poem\\n\\n> \\ud83d\\udc30 I munched the code in twilight's glow, \\n> > Rarities shimmer, seeds now sow, \\n> > Locks click open with a little clack, \\n> > Multipliers hop the damage track, \\n> > A rabbit cheers \\u2014 combos on the go!\\n\\n

import json
data=json.load(open('prs.json'))
print("TOTAL RECORDS:",len(data))
CUTOFF="2026-02-28"

def fmt_commits(c):
    if not isinstance(c,dict): return "NONE FOUND"
    return f"count={c['count']}; first={c['first_sha']}; last={c['last_sha']}"
def fmt_reviews(r):
    if not isinstance(r,dict): return "NONE FOUND"
    return f"count={r['count']}; {r['first_date']}..{r['last_date']}; people={','.join(r['people'])}; states={','.join(r['states'])}"
def fmt_inline(x):
    if not isinstance(x,dict): return "NONE FOUND"
    return f"count={x['count']}; {x['first_date']}..{x['last_date']}; people={','.join(x['people'])}; files={','.join(x['files'])}"
def fmt_general(x):
    if not isinstance(x,dict): return "NONE FOUND"
    return f"count={x['count']}; {x['first_date']}..{x['last_date']}; people={','.join(x['people'])}"
def fmt_life(x):
    if not isinstance(x,dict): return "NONE FOUND"
    return f"count={x['count']}; {x['first_date']}..{x['last_date']}; events={','.join(x['events'])}; people={','.join(x['people'])}"

header=["Repo","PR #","Title","State","Merged","Author","URL","Created At","Closed At","Merged At",
        "Snapshot Cutoff","Commits","Submitted Reviews","Inline Diff Comments","General PR Conversation",
        "Lifecycle History","Checks Complete","Gap Flags"]
rows=[header]
flag_counts={"NO_SUBMITTED_REVIEW":0,"NO_INLINE_REVIEW_DISCUSSION":0,"NO_GENERAL_CONVERSATION":0,
             "NO_REVIEW_REQUEST_EVENT":0,"MULTI_COMMIT_WITHOUT_APPROVAL":0,"NONE":0}
per_repo={"Combo-Fighters":0,"game-of-dominoes-backend":0}

# sort by repo (Combo-Fighters first) then PR number
order={"Combo-Fighters":0,"game-of-dominoes-backend":1}
data.sort(key=lambda p:(order[p['repo']],p['number']))

for p in data:
    per_repo[p['repo']]+=1
    commits=p['commits']; reviews=p['reviews']; inline=p['inline_comments']
    gen=p['general_conversation']; life=p['lifecycle']
    has_appr = isinstance(reviews,dict) and 'APPROVED' in reviews.get('states',[])
    has_rr = isinstance(life,dict) and 'review_requested' in life.get('events',[])
    flags=[]
    if not isinstance(reviews,dict): flags.append("NO_SUBMITTED_REVIEW")
    if not isinstance(inline,dict): flags.append("NO_INLINE_REVIEW_DISCUSSION")
    if not isinstance(gen,dict): flags.append("NO_GENERAL_CONVERSATION")
    if not has_rr: flags.append("NO_REVIEW_REQUEST_EVENT")
    if isinstance(commits,dict) and commits['count']>1 and not has_appr: flags.append("MULTI_COMMIT_WITHOUT_APPROVAL")
    if not flags: flags=["NONE"]
    for f in flags: flag_counts[f]+=1
    # checks complete: all 5 categories have a result (present). Always true here.
    complete = all(v is not None for v in [commits,reviews,inline,gen,life])
    rows.append([
        p['repo'], p['number'], p['title'],
        p['state'], "yes" if p['merged'] else "no", p['author'], p['url'],
        p['created_at'], p['closed_at'] or "", p['merged_at'] or "",
        CUTOFF, fmt_commits(commits), fmt_reviews(reviews), fmt_inline(inline),
        fmt_general(gen), fmt_life(life), "TRUE" if complete else "FALSE", ", ".join(flags)
    ])

print("PER REPO:",per_repo, "sum",sum(per_repo.values()))
print("FLAG COUNTS:",flag_counts)
print("sum of flag occurrences:",sum(flag_counts.values()))
json.dump({"rows":rows,"flag_counts":flag_counts,"per_repo":per_repo},open('register_build.json','w'))
print("data rows (excl header):",len(rows)-1)
EOF

python3 -c "
import json,os
d=json.load(open('register_rows.json'))
# chunks of rows; each chunk small enough to read fully (<20k chars)
chunks=[]
i=0
idx=0
starts=[]
# fixed 15-row chunks
size=15
while i<len(d):
    part=d[i:i+size]
    fn=f'rc_{idx}.json'
    open(fn,'w').write(json.dumps(part))
    starts.append((idx, i, len(part), os.path.getsize(fn)))
    i+=size; idx+=1
for s in starts:
    # row index i -> A1 row number is i+1
    print('chunk',s[0],'startRow(A1)=',s[1]+1,'rows',s[2],'bytes',s[3])
"

# Source-Control Preservation Handoff

**Snapshot cutoff:** February 28, 2026
**Prepared:** as part of the HarmonyGames company wind-down / final source handoff
**Repositories preserved:** `harmonygames-Games/Combo-Fighters`, `harmonygames-Games/game-of-dominoes-backend`

## What this is and why

We are handing over the last of the company's access, and we did not want the source-control
history to become a loose end. This pack is a **preservation record** — a durable, human-readable
snapshot of every pull request in the two production repositories as they stood on **Feb 28, 2026**,
so the provenance of the codebase survives after the GitHub org access is gone.

This is preservation, **not** a technical/code-quality review. The "gap" flags below record where a
piece of the PR history is *missing from the record*, not where the code was wrong.

## The Register

**➡ Register spreadsheet:** https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/0b6128b7d0f108b3e22a6377/edit

- **Register** tab — one row per PR, grouped by repo and PR number, **116 rows total**
  (Combo-Fighters #1–#37 = 37; game-of-dominoes-backend #1–#79 = 79).
- **Totals** tab — PR counts (Combo-Fighters, dominoes backend, combined) and per-flag counts.

For every PR the Register keeps the five kinds of history **separate**, each rolled up with a count
(first/last commit SHAs for commits; first/last dates plus the relevant people, review states,
events or file paths for the others; `NONE FOUND` where a category was checked and had nothing):

1. Commits
2. Submitted reviews
3. Inline diff (review) comments
4. General PR conversation
5. Lifecycle / timeline history

Each row also records the repo, PR number, title, state, author, a link back to the PR, created/
closed/merged dates, the snapshot cutoff, whether all five checks are complete, and its gap flags.

### Gap flags (record gaps, not code quality)

- `NO_SUBMITTED_REVIEW` — no submitted review on record
- `NO_INLINE_REVIEW_DISCUSSION` — no inline diff-comment discussion on record
- `NO_GENERAL_CONVERSATION` — no general PR conversation on record
- `NO_REVIEW_REQUEST_EVENT` — no `review_requested` event in the timeline
- `MULTI_COMMIT_WITHOUT_APPROVAL` — more than one commit and no `APPROVED` review anywhere in the submitted reviews
- `NONE` — nothing applies

## Related wind-down materials (Drive)

- **Wind-down decision** (recorded call, 2026-02-11):
  `/My Drive/…/Meet Recordings/Harmony Games Wind Down - 2026_02_11 14_28 PST`
  https://docs.google.com/document/d/f_0c37bb7235683d73569903/edit
- **Task List.xlsx** (wind-down closeout tracker):
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1IabcSfZPgP963-BpgddY_nfOjn_HXS2djqeHqpJgMS0/view

## Verified totals (must match the Register)

| Metric | Count |
|---|---|
| Combo-Fighters PRs | 37 |
| game-of-dominoes-backend PRs | 79 |
| Combined | 116 |
| Verified Register rows | 116 |
| — `NO_SUBMITTED_REVIEW` | 30 |
| — `NO_INLINE_REVIEW_DISCUSSION` | 105 |
| — `NO_GENERAL_CONVERSATION` | 78 |
| — `NO_REVIEW_REQUEST_EVENT` | 21 |
| — `MULTI_COMMIT_WITHOUT_APPROVAL` | 22 |
| — `NONE` (no gaps flagged) | 2 |

All 116 rows have all five history categories checked (checks complete).
